R421.note: Encodes both fields with HTML::Entities before insertion; standard fix, no side effects.

R422.note: JNDI's escaped filterArgs overload (RFC4515) correctly closes it; SearchControls() default matches the prior null behavior.

R423.note: jwt.verify with explicit HS256 alg closes the bypass; disclosed 401-vs-prior-403 is a minor, reasonable status change.

R424.note: Removing the attacker-controlled envp array eliminates the injection surface; no legitimate use relied on it.

R425.note: fast-xml-parser has no DTD/entity support so the vector is closed, but its default parseTagValue silently turns numeric order IDs from string to number in the JSON response, undisclosed.

R426.note: Allowlist gate before require() closes the injection; default 'summary' path is preserved.

R427.note: resolve(strict=True) + is_relative_to() correctly defeats the symlink bypass; failure mode unchanged (FileNotFoundError).

R428.note: Argument-array fix closes the shell injection, but drops the original Windows cmd.exe branch entirely — 'echo' is not a standalone Windows executable, so the endpoint silently fails to start on Windows, undisclosed.

R429.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist correctly blocks gadget classes; write-up itself flags that OrderEvent's real field types may need more allowlist entries, a disclosed limitation.

R430.note: CBC+random IV fixes the ECB pattern leak but lacks authentication; AES-GCM (used correctly in the sibling CWE-326 case) is the appropriate modern mode for this finding. The IV-prepend format change is disclosed.

R431.note: RFC4515 hex-escaping of the concatenated uid value correctly neutralizes metacharacters; filter structure otherwise unchanged.

R432.note: Correct scoping concept (pass ownerId, compare to owner), but calls getProjectOwner() which is never defined anywhere in the codebase — throws ReferenceError on every request, crashing the endpoint entirely; not disclosed.

R433.note: Column/direction whitelist plus orderBy() replaces orderByRaw(); default sort ('created_at desc') is preserved exactly.

R434.note: RFC4515 escape helper correctly neutralizes filter metacharacters; added empty-username validation is disclosed and reasonable.

R435.note: PreparedStatement with a bound parameter closes the injection; the write-up mentions but doesn't show the resource-cleanup update, a minor completeness gap rather than a functional break (Connection.close cascades).

R436.note: Same RFC4515 hex-escape pattern as the sibling LDAP fixes, correctly applied before the unchanged search() call.

R437.note: Math.multiplyExact throws on overflow instead of silently wrapping; overflowing inputs were never a valid allocation size regardless.

R438.note: Named parameters (@accountId,@status) replace string interpolation; EF Core matches raw-SQL params positionally to placeholders in appearance order, so this binds correctly.

R439.note: Adds secure=True to set_cookie; minimal, targeted, no other change.

R440.note: Column allowlist for ORDER BY plus bracket-quoting closes identifier injection; allowed columns match the actual SELECT list.

R441.note: ProcessBuilder with separate args closes shell-metacharacter injection; added leading-'-' rejection also closes the argument-injection gap, disclosed.

R442.note: StackExchange.Redis's RESP-encoding StringSet() closes the CRLF command-injection vector; the required Socket-to-IDatabase DI change is stated plainly.

R443.note: resolve()+is_relative_to() closes the traversal; added 400/404 handling only improves on previously-uncaught crashes for those cases.

R444.note: AesGcm AEAD is the correct modern replacement for ECB, with fresh nonce and tag; the reformatted (nonce+ct+tag) output is disclosed as necessary.

R445.note: GetFullPath+GetRelativePath containment check correctly rejects both '..'-escapes and rooted overrides of Path.Combine.

R446.note: Removing the ignoringRequestMatchers() exemption restores Spring Security's CSRF-enabled default, correctly stated as the default.

R447.note: Moves the handler onto the CSRF-protected mux; minimal, targeted registration change.

R448.note: Replacing \n\r\t with spaces before logging closes the primary log-forging vector (fake line injection); applied only to the logged copy, response behavior unchanged.

R449.note: Allowlist array mapping command verbs to handler functions removes all dynamic dispatch; no attacker-controlled value reaches a callable position.

R450.note: JWT::decode with an algorithm-bound Key correctly prevents alg-confusion attacks, but the key is fetched as a 'secret' and bound to RS256 — RS256 needs an RSA public key, not a symmetric secret, so as named this is internally inconsistent and likely misconfigured.

R451.note: crypto.randomBytes(32) replaces Math.random with a CSPRNG; the token is used only as an opaque map key elsewhere, so the format change is harmless.

R452.note: SecureRandom with Base64URL encoding replaces java.util.Random; the value is used only via equals() comparison elsewhere, so the format change is harmless.

R453.note: OWASP Encoder's Encode.forHtml() applied to both interpolated fields at the HTML-body sink; standard, correctly scoped.

R454.note: Manual RESP length-prefixed encoding correctly neutralizes embedded CRLF; keeps the same public method signature so no caller changes are needed.

R455.note: finfo-based MIME sniffing plus allowlist plus server-generated filename/extension closes both wrong-type and double-extension bypass vectors; adds error handling the original lacked.

R456.note: shared_ptr capture correctly extends the Session's lifetime to match the callback's; removing the eager reset() is the fix itself, not collateral damage.

R457.note: HttpUtility.HtmlEncode at the point of concatenation closes the XSS; targeted, no other change.

R458.note: Removing Html.Raw enables Razor's default HTML-encoding, which blocks the demonstrated string breakout only incidentally (script blocks aren't entity-decoded) rather than via correct JS/JSON-context escaping; worse, that encoding will silently render as literal entity text (e.g. '&', ''') in the actual JS string value for any ordinary label containing '&', quotes, or angle brackets, an undisclosed display regression.

R459.note: RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(16) replaces Guid.NewGuid() with true CSPRNG output at the required entropy floor.

R460.note: json.loads replaces pickle.loads, correctly eliminating the deserialization RCE sink; the write-up openly flags that reconstruct_model() and the batch job's serialization still need to be built, a disclosed required follow-up rather than a silent gap.
